svg.text: Riser trimming: support the hole and close its actual perimeter
31 October 2026 / unadopted B plan / mm / conditional geometry, no capacity or construction approval
A Local trimmer on adjacent full-length planks
100 mm y tails: AUTHOR sensitivity; transverse tab widths are symbolic.
Orange: ground plant door below. Its arch receives changed floor reactions.
Adjacent field widths 880 / 980 do not select stock panels or cut strands.
Clear bay 700 × 800; gross riser 550 × 700; dashed cabinet 600 × 750.
B A cabinet outline is not a floor closure
Bay beyond cabinet footprint:
15 west / 85 east
25 south / 25 north
0.110 m² of the floor opening
lies outside the cabinet footprint.
The cabinet itself also needs
a defined supporting load path.
C Independent frame: different members, same receiving walls
Two cross-span members flank the hole; an east-side header joins them.
At the illustrative 100 mm edge bands:
South y4550–4650 lies wholly over ground door y3900–5300.
North y5450–5550 clears its upper jamb by 150 mm in plan.
That gap is neither a bearing length nor an arch/abutment verdict.
D Keep the complete section budget
Retained HC soffit +3170; ceiling top +3115; services 55.
Remaining service depth = 55 − trim downstand − protection.
The primary detail supplies none of those installed section dimensions.
Top tabs, topping, wet/fire/acoustic closure and finishes also need space.
Advance a supplier-designed strap enquiry, with actual adjacent panels and a supported perimeter closure.
Retain the independent frame comparator. Neither earns a chosen floor, member, material exception or STR-HOUSE completion.
Primary detail: Ibstock/Coltman current colour isometric; width label up to1200 mm; no bearing, plate or shelf dimensions.
Source-bound inputs and reproduction: house-riser-trim.mjs / house-riser-trim.json. Full technical, physical and professional duties remain.
